compiled:
📰 General

Giants and Harbaugh Remain Locked in Contract Negotiations Over Specific Language •

The New York Giants and head coach John Harbaugh are continuing to negotiate the terms of his contract extension. According to ESPN’s Adam Schefter, the primary point of contention revolves around specific wording within the agreement. Neither team has finalized the deal, with discussions focused on clarifying the precise language used. The Giants and Harbaugh are currently working through the remaining details to reach a mutually acceptable agreement.

🌍 World

Devastating Floods and Rainfall Trigger Deaths and Evacuations Across Southern Africa •

Torrential rains and resulting flooding have caused widespread devastation across South Africa, Mozambique, and Zimbabwe. At least 100 people have died due to the extreme weather conditions, with rescue efforts primarily focused on evacuating individuals from affected areas. Military helicopters were deployed to assist in the rescue of those stranded on rooftops, while significant numbers of tourists and workers were removed from the Kruger National Park. The flooding has displaced thousands and caused extensive damage to infrastructure and homes in the region.

🦅 US

ICE Agent Involved in Minneapolis Shooting Received Specialized Training in Fugitive Tracking •

An Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent was involved in the shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis on January 16th. Jonathan Ross, the agent, was conducting surveillance as part of his role with ICE. Ross was trained to track and apprehend fugitives, utilizing techniques developed for locating and capturing individuals who have violated immigration laws. The incident is currently under investigation by the Minneapolis Police Department and ICE.

💰 Business

Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind Project Resumes Construction Following Trump Suspension •

The Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project is restarting construction following a federal judge’s order to lift the Trump administration’s suspension. The project, the largest offshore wind development currently underway in the United States, had been halted due to legal challenges regarding its environmental impact assessment. Judge Jackson’s ruling determined that the suspension was not justified, allowing Dominion Energy to continue with the construction phase. The project aims to generate enough electricity to power approximately 750,000 homes.

💻 Technology

WWE 2K26 Expanding Gameplay with Four New Match Types Revealed •

WWE 2K26 is set to launch in just over two months and will introduce four new match types to its gameplay roster. These additions include a Steel Cage match, a WarGames match, a Last Man Standing match, and a Triple Threat Match. The game will also feature CM Punk as the centerpiece of the Showcase mode, offering fans a dedicated experience with his career highlights. Details regarding the specific rules and mechanics for each new match type are currently under wraps, pending the game’s release.

🎭 Entertainment

Sarandos Defends Netflix’s 45-Day Movie Window, Addresses Trump Comments •

Netflix’s Chief Content Officer, Ted Sarandos, reiterated the company’s established strategy of a 45-day window between theatrical release and streaming availability for Warner Bros. titles. During an interview with the New York Times, Sarandos defended this approach, stating it largely remains unchanged since the Warner Bros. Discovery merger. He addressed previous comments regarding former President Donald Trump’s views on movie theaters, confirming he had previously made those remarks. Sarandos emphasized the continued importance of theatrical releases alongside the streaming strategy.

🏅 Sports

Red Sox Eye Rotation Shakeup Following Suárez Acquisition and Recent Trades •

Following the signing of Ranger Suárez to a five-year, $130 million deal, the Boston Red Sox are reportedly considering further roster adjustments within their starting rotation. The team recently acquired Sonny Gray and Johan Oviedo through trades, creating potential surplus in the pitching staff. This move suggests the Red Sox are evaluating their long-term rotation strategy after bolstering it with established and younger arms. The organization is now likely assessing whether to trade from their rotation depth to reshape the group for the 2026 season.

🔬 Science

Ancient Human Footprints Unearthed on Moroccan Beach Reveal 90,000-Year-Old Trackways •

Eighty-five fossilized human footprints were discovered on a beach in northern Morocco, providing new insights into early human activity. The footprints, dating back approximately 90,000 years, were identified as belonging to a group of Homo sapiens. Researchers believe the tracks represent some of the oldest known human tracings of their kind. The discovery offers a valuable opportunity to study the behavior and movement patterns of early humans in North Africa.

🩺 Health

Keto Diet Triggered Rare, Disfiguring Rash in Young Man’s Unexpected Reaction •

A 20-year-old man experienced a severe and unusual skin reaction following a rapid transition to a ketogenic diet. Doctors reported the case in the New England Journal of Medicine, detailing the development of a rare dermatosis. The condition, characterized by extensive blistering and scaling, was initially attributed to a potential reaction to dietary changes. Researchers identified a previously unreported autoimmune response as the likely cause, linked to the rapid shift in macronutrient intake. Further investigation is underway to fully understand the mechanism behind this unusual reaction.
